verdicts.reason: HOL4 RESULT_def has only RESULT (Result t) = t. Defn tries Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition first, which uses new_specification and saves only the stated clause, with no ARB completion. No other theorem in the package fixes RESULT on Clash. The Lean clause `.Clash t => t` proves RESULT (Clash t) = t, e.g. RESULT (Clash 0) = 0, by rfl, an equation HOL4 leaves open.

HOL4 CLASH_def has only CLASH (Clash t) = t, introduced through primitive-recursion new_specification, so the value on Result is unspecified. No other theorem in the package fixes it; INST_CORE only uses CLASH when IS_RESULT is false. The Lean clause `.Result t => t` proves CLASH (Result t) = t, e.g. CLASH (Result 0) = 0, by rfl, an equation HOL4 leaves open.
